function.name: xiaohongshu_publish
function.description: Validate, inspect, fill, dispatch an upstream draft/publish/schedule decision, schedule, publish, or verify one local Xiaohongshu image-post manifest. Mutating commands require exact user authorization and commit=true.

decision.description: Required only for dispatch. Must equal the manifest mode exactly.

manifest.description: Absolute manifest path; null only for preflight.

profile_dir.description: Absolute dedicated Chrome profile path for managed-launch fallback; otherwise null.

cdp_url.description: Preferred existing Chrome CDP URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:9222; null only for validate or managed-launch fallback.

commit.description: True only after exact authorization for fill, draft, schedule, publish, or dispatch.
